purpose: Define the only acceptable interface for regenerating current canonical G8 currency Macro states from validated Macro data without inventing a universal score or changing the frozen engine semantics.

frozen_semantics.pair_macro_rule: Compare the two canonical currency Macro polarities: A if macroA > macroB, B if macroB > macroA, otherwise MIXED/TIE.

state_contract.FAVOREVOLE: Directional positive Macro state only when the currency-specific decision rule has valid, fresh and evidence-backed support.
state_contract.CONTRARIO: Directional negative Macro state only when the currency-specific decision rule has valid, fresh and evidence-backed support.
state_contract.DIVERGENTE: Two or more valid Macro dimensions provide materially conflicting directional information under the currency-specific rule.
state_contract.NEUTRALE: Valid and sufficiently complete Macro evidence is genuinely balanced/non-directional under the currency-specific rule. Missing data cannot produce NEUTRALE.
state_contract.WITHHELD: Required evidence is missing, stale, non-PIT, ambiguous, or the currency-specific decision rule is not yet certified. WITHHELD is not zero and not neutral.

forbidden_methods: single universal threshold applied to all currencies
post-hoc threshold tuning to reproduce current CERT53 anchors
using CB/rates/price/COT/liquidity to flip or manufacture the primary Macro state
treating missing or stale Macro inputs as neutral
using the historical frozen currencyIntelData labels as current live truth
using current CERT53 pair anchors as training labels without provenance and OOS controls
validation_sequence: reconstruct or document the historical methodology that produced the frozen currency Macro labels if recoverable
define each currency decision table before observing future outcomes used for validation
compare architecture/parity without forcing historical labels
run historical PIT replay where source coverage allows
only then enable Macro ingest propagation into pair anchors

current_gate.reason: No certified executable current currency Macro regenerator exists yet.
